toolbar.syncBreakpoints: Sync the source with the current breakpoint

@toolbar.syncBreakpoints.context: Tooltip of the IDE toolbar toggle button that makes the code editor follow the breakpoint the machine stopped at.

@toolbar.showMemory.context: Tooltip of the IDE toolbar toggle button that opens or closes the Memory panel.

@toolbar.showDisassembly.context: Tooltip of the IDE toolbar toggle button that opens or closes the Disassembly panel.

@toolbar.stayOnTop.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar toggle button that keeps the emulator window above other windows.

@toolbar.instantScreen.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar toggle button for the instant screen, which shows the screen memory's current content immediately instead of the beam-accurate picture.

toolbar.beamPosition: Show/Hide the beam position while paused

@toolbar.beamPosition.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar toggle button that overlays the raster (electron) beam position on the screen while the machine is paused.

toolbar.mouse.captured: Mouse captured – press Esc to release

@toolbar.mouse.captured.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar mouse button while the emulated machine has captured the host mouse pointer. Esc is the key name.

@toolbar.mouse.capture.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar button that captures the host mouse pointer for the emulated machine's mouse. Esc is the key name.

toolbar.mouse.disabled: Mouse capture is switched off in the Machine | Mouse menu

@toolbar.mouse.disabled.context: Tooltip of the disabled emulator toolbar mouse-capture button. 'Machine | Mouse' is the menu path (Machine menu, Mouse submenu); translate it the way those menus are translated.

@toolbar.keyboard.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar toggle button that shows or hides the virtual keyboard of the emulated machine.

@toolbar.sound.mute.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar sound button while sound is on: a click mutes it.

@toolbar.sound.unmute.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar sound button while sound is muted: a click turns it back on.

@toolbar.sound.level.context: Tooltip of the small drop-down arrow next to the emulator toolbar's sound button; it opens the list of volume levels.

@toolbar.fastLoad.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar toggle button for fast tape loading. LOAD is the ZX Spectrum BASIC keyword and stays in English capitals.

@toolbar.rewindTape.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar button that rewinds the emulated cassette tape to its start.

toolbar.record.start: Start video recording — the arrow next to it has the other recordings

@toolbar.record.start.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar record button while nothing is recording: a click starts a screen video recording; the drop-down arrow beside it offers the other kinds of recording.

toolbar.record.armed: Ready – waiting for machine to run (click to cancel)

@toolbar.record.armed.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar record button while a video recording is armed and will start when the emulated machine runs.

@toolbar.record.recording.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar record button while a video recording runs.

@toolbar.record.paused.context: Tooltip of the emulator toolbar record button while a video recording is paused (the machine is paused).

@toolbar.record.menu.context: Tooltip of the drop-down arrow next to the emulator toolbar's record button; it opens a menu of recording commands.

@toolbar.record.startIdeEmu.context: Item of the record button's drop-down menu on the emulator toolbar: starts a video recording of both the IDE and emulator windows.

@toolbar.record.stopIdeEmu.context: Item of the record button's drop-down menu on the emulator toolbar: stops the running IDE + emulator window recording.

@toolbar.record.ideEmuTitle.context: Title of the message box that explains why the IDE + emulator window recording could not start or stop.

@toolbar.start.debugMachine.context: Emulator toolbar: tooltip of the start button, and its drop-down menu item, that starts the emulated machine in debug mode (breakpoints active). Ctrl+F5 is the shortcut.

@toolbar.start.runMachine.context: Emulator toolbar: tooltip of the start button, and its drop-down menu item, that starts the emulated machine normally. 'Run' as in execute. F5 is the shortcut.

@toolbar.start.debugProject.context: IDE toolbar: tooltip of the start button, and its drop-down menu item, that builds the project and runs it in debug mode (breakpoints active). Ctrl+F5 is the shortcut.

@toolbar.start.runProject.context: IDE toolbar: tooltip of the start button, and its drop-down menu item, that builds the project and runs it normally. 'Run' as in execute. F5 is the shortcut.

@toolbar.start.chooseMode.context: Tooltip of the drop-down arrow next to the toolbar's start button; it chooses between running and debugging.

@toolbar.resume.continue.context: Toolbar: tooltip of the resume button, and its drop-down menu item, that continues a paused machine normally. F5 is the shortcut.

@toolbar.resume.continueDebugging.context: Toolbar: tooltip of the resume button, and its drop-down menu item, that continues a paused machine in debug mode. Ctrl+F5 is the shortcut.

@toolbar.resume.chooseMode.context: Tooltip of the drop-down arrow next to the toolbar's resume (continue) button; it chooses between continuing normally and continuing in debug mode.

toolbar.resume.chooseModeFromPresent: Choose resume mode - resumes from the present

@toolbar.resume.chooseModeFromPresent.context: Tooltip of the drop-down arrow next to the toolbar's resume button, in the execution history (the past). Shown while the debugger is in the execution history (the past): stepping acts on the live machine, so the text says it resumes from the present.

@toolbar.pause.context: Tooltip of the toolbar button that pauses the running emulated machine. Shift+F5 is the shortcut.

@toolbar.stop.context: Tooltip of the toolbar button that stops (turns off) the emulated machine. F4 is the shortcut.

@toolbar.restart.context: Tooltip of the toolbar button that restarts the emulated machine (or rebuilds and reruns the project). Shift+F4 is the shortcut.

@toolbar.step.into.context: Tooltip of the toolbar debugger button that executes one instruction or statement, entering called routines.

placeholders.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut, shown verbatim, e.g. 'F10' or 'Shift+F12'

toolbar.step.intoFromPresent: Step Into ({shortcut}) - resumes from the present

@toolbar.step.intoFromPresent.context: Tooltip of the toolbar Step Into button in the execution history. Shown while the debugger is in the execution history (the past): stepping acts on the live machine, so the text says it resumes from the present.

placeholders.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut, shown verbatim, e.g. 'F10' or 'Shift+F12'

@toolbar.step.intoTarget.context: Item of the Step Into drop-down on the toolbar: steps into the named routine that the current BASIC statement calls.

placeholders.name: Name of a SUB or FUNCTION in the user's program, shown verbatim

@toolbar.step.intoTargetMenu.context: Tooltip of the drop-down arrow next to the toolbar's Step Into button; it lists the routines the current statement calls, to step into one of them.

@toolbar.step.over.context: Tooltip of the toolbar debugger button that executes one instruction or statement, running called routines without stopping in them.

placeholders.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut, shown verbatim, e.g. 'F10' or 'Shift+F12'

toolbar.step.overFromPresent: Step Over ({shortcut}) - resumes from the present

@toolbar.step.overFromPresent.context: Tooltip of the toolbar Step Over button in the execution history. Shown while the debugger is in the execution history (the past): stepping acts on the live machine, so the text says it resumes from the present.

placeholders.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut, shown verbatim, e.g. 'F10' or 'Shift+F12'

@toolbar.step.out.context: Tooltip of the toolbar debugger button that runs until the current routine returns to its caller.

placeholders.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut, shown verbatim, e.g. 'F10' or 'Shift+F12'

toolbar.step.outFromPresent: Step Out ({shortcut}) - resumes from the present

@toolbar.step.outFromPresent.context: Tooltip of the toolbar Step Out button in the execution history. Shown while the debugger is in the execution history (the past): stepping acts on the live machine, so the text says it resumes from the present.

placeholders.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut, shown verbatim, e.g. 'F10' or 'Shift+F12'

@toolbar.step.overLine.context: Tooltip of the toolbar debugger button that runs a whole BASIC source line (all its statements). Shift+F10 is the shortcut.

toolbar.stepMode.source: Stepping source statements (click to step Z80 instructions)

@toolbar.stepMode.source.context: Tooltip of the toolbar toggle that chooses what the step buttons step: currently BASIC source statements. Z80 is the processor's name.

toolbar.stepMode.z80: Stepping Z80 instructions (click to step source statements)

@toolbar.stepMode.z80.context: Tooltip of the toolbar toggle that chooses what the step buttons step: currently single Z80 machine-code instructions. Z80 is the processor's name.

@toolbar.history.stepBack.context: Tooltip of the toolbar button that moves one instruction back in the recorded execution history (reverse debugging).

placeholders.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut, shown verbatim, e.g. 'F10' or 'Shift+F12'

@toolbar.history.stepForward.context: Tooltip of the toolbar button that moves one instruction forward in the recorded execution history, toward the present.

placeholders.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut, shown verbatim, e.g. 'F10' or 'Shift+F12'

@toolbar.history.present.context: Tooltip of the toolbar button that leaves the execution history and returns to the machine's live (present) state.

toolbar.step.outInMain: Step Out: the main program has nothing to return to

@toolbar.step.outInMain.context: Tooltip of the disabled Step Out button while source-level stepping in the main program. 'Step Out' is the button's name.
